data.title: A quieter corner of the sound room
data.goal: A quieter corner of the sound room

memoryNodes.cue: A board names the study of sound.
The reading changes with the demonstration.
A limit triggers the warning light.

data.situation:
The sound room was behind a heavy door. A board introduced acoustics, while a screen displayed a sound level in decibels. Jo stood still as the attendant moved a recorded sound to another setting. The change was appreciable, large enough to notice, although a separate tiny variation was described as negligible for that demonstration. A chart used magnitude for the size of a measured difference. Another label marked a threshold at which a warning light would come on. Maya read a researcher’s note about a statistically insignificant result and noticed that it did not simply say the whole experiment was unimportant. Jo: Does insignificant mean the result is useless?
Attendant: This note says statistically insignificant. That is a statement about the analysis.
Maya: And the warning light?
Attendant: It has its own threshold, shown on that label.

readingBlocks.en: The sound room was behind a heavy door. A board introduced acoustics, while a screen displayed a sound level in decibels. Jo stood still as the attendant moved a recorded sound to another setting. The change was appreciable, large enough to notice, although a separate tiny variation was described as negligible for that demonstration. A chart used magnitude for the size of a measured difference. Another label marked a threshold at which a warning light would come on. readingBlocks.zh: 声音室在厚门后。展牌介绍声学，屏幕以分贝显示声级。工作人员把录制声音调到另一档时，乔站着不动。这次变化可察觉，足够明显；另一次很小的变化则被说明为对本演示可忽略。图表用 magnitude 表示测量差异的大小。另一标签标出警示灯亮起的阈值。玛雅读到研究者写的“统计上不显著”结果，注意到这并不是说整个实验不重要。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Does insignificant mean the result is useless?
Attendant: This note says statistically insignificant. That is a statement about the analysis.
Maya: And the warning light?
Attendant: It has its own threshold, shown on that label.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：不显著意味着结果没用吗？
工作人员：这份说明写统计上不显著，是关于分析的判断。
玛雅：那警示灯呢？
工作人员：它有自己的阈值，写在那张标签上。

glossary.note: 声学作为学科通常配单数动词；也可指房间的音响效果。

externalEvidence.definition: the study of the physical properties of sound

glossary.zh: 用于表示声级等比值的对数单位；分贝
glossary.note: 分贝；对数单位，数值变化不表示响度按同一比例变化。
glossary.example: The screen displayed a level in decibels.

externalEvidence.definition: a logarithmic unit of sound intensity; 10 times the logarithm of the ratio of the sound intensity to some reference intensity

glossary.zh: 大到足以察觉的；可观的
glossary.note: 大到可察觉或测量的；不表示“值得感激的”。
glossary.example: The change in the reading was appreciable.

externalEvidence.definition: enough to be estimated or measured

glossary.note: 小到在当前目的下可以忽略；须考虑测量误差和用途。
glossary.example: The tiny variation was negligible for this demonstration.
glossary.exampleZh: 这点变化在本演示中可忽略。

externalEvidence.definition: so small as to be meaningless; insignificant

glossary.zh: 某事物的大小、数量或程度
glossary.note: 差异或变化的幅度；the magnitude of a change。
glossary.example: The chart showed the magnitude of the difference.

externalEvidence.definition: the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)

glossary.zh: 某种变化或反应开始出现的界限；阈值
glossary.note: 达到后开始发生某种效果的界限；reach a threshold。
glossary.example: The light came on at the marked threshold.

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Level where event/effect begins; not just sensory detection.

glossary.zh: 统计分析中未显示显著性的；不显著的
glossary.note: statistically insignificant 不等于没有效应或没有实际价值。
glossary.example: The note described a statistically insignificant result.
glossary.exampleZh: 说明描述一个统计上不显著的结果。

externalEvidence.label: American Statistical Association
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Statistical significance does not measure effect size or practical importance; original source statistical context retained.
